parameters.help_en: The ID of the smart tagging job. You can obtain this ID from the response to the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478786.html call
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的智能标签作业ID。可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478786.html的返回参数中获取
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en:
Additional request parameters, formatted as a JSON string. For example: `{"labelResultType":"auto"}`. The `labelResultType` parameter supports the following values:

`auto`: machine-generated tagging results

`hmi`: human-in-the-loop tagging results
parameters.help_zh:
额外的请求参数，使用JSON字符串表示，例如：{"labelResultType":"auto"}。其中，labelResultType为String类型，可取值：

auto：机器打标结果

hmi：人机协同结果
parameters.name: params

JobStatus.description_en:
The job status. Valid values:

Success: The job was successful.

Fail: The job failed.

Processing: The job is in progress.

Submitted: The job is queued for processing
JobStatus.description_zh:
任务状态，可取值：

Success：处理成功。

Fail：处理失败。

Processing：处理中。

Submitted：已提交等待处理

Result.description_en: An array of analysis result objects

Data.description_en: The analysis result data, formatted as a JSON string. The data structure depends on the `Type` value. For more information, see the `Result` parameter descriptions below
Data.description_zh: 分析结果的具体数据，以JSON字符串表示。不同Type的数据结构见下文Result参数说明

Type.description_en:
The type of the analysis result.

[ ] - Analysis result types for Tagging v1.0:

TextLabel: text labels

VideoLabel: video labels

ASR: Raw results from automatic speech recognition. This is not returned by default.

OCR: Raw results from optical character recognition. This is not returned by default.

NLP: Results from natural language processing. This is not returned by default.

[ ] - Analysis result types for Tagging v2.0:

CPVLabel

Meta: Metadata such as the video title. This is not returned by default.

[ ] - Analysis result types for Tagging v2.0-custom:

CPVLabel

Meta: Metadata such as the video title. This is not returned by default
Type.description_zh:
分析结果的类型。

[ ] - 标签1.0分析结果类型：


TextLabel：文本标签
VideoLabel：视频标签
ASR：语音识别原始结果（默认不返回）
OCR：文字识别原始结果（默认不返回）
NLP：NLP处理结果（默认不返回）


[ ] - 标签2.0分析结果类型：

CPVLabel
Meta：视频标题等信息（默认不返回）

[ ] - 标签2.0-custom分析结果类型：

CPVLabel
Meta：视频标题等信息（默认不返回）

UserData.description_en: The custom data passed through the MNS callback. For details on the message format, see the callback message format definitions below
UserData.description_zh: 通过MNS回调时透传回来的信息。消息格式请参见下文回调消息格式定义
